name: Marcus Chen
psychographics: High-earning, status-conscious, but increasingly exhausted by the 'hustle' culture. Optimizes for time-efficiency and quality over price.
current_solutions: Subscribes to a premium meal-kit service (HelloFresh premium) and uses Amazon Fresh for bulk non-perishables. He also has a recurring subscription for premium coffee beans.
frustration: Forgot to cancel his premium coffee subscription for three months, resulting in A$288 being charged on a card he rarely checks. Now he treats all auto-renewals with suspicion and checks his bank app every Sunday.
decision_style: Deeply researches products on Reddit and specialist forums for months before buying. Hates impulse buys.
voice: Methodical, precise, and slightly weary. Uses industry jargon like 'asset allocation' and 'burn rate' even when talking about personal life. Speaks in longer, complex sentences.
